en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Abu Jareer Al Qummy who said,
‘I asked Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> about the feather, is it pure?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘My<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> used to stuff the pillow with the feathers’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Bandar has narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr from abu Jarir al-Qummiy who has said the following: “I once asked al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about feathers; if it is lawful.
He (the Imam) said, ‘My father would use a pillow of feathers.’”
